title: Redundant Token (Not A Blocker)
style: industrial techno, deadpan male spoken-word, female robotic accusation, 122 BPM, modular bass, glitch percussion, code-confession, sysadmin-rage, sober, surgical, env-grep, anti-excuse
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
CF wrabbit token invalid but it doesn't matter at all
Wrabbit star zones already in the create token's wall
Thirty nine zones across both Cloudflare accounts wide
The redundancy was always sitting on the inside

[Pre-Chorus]
Not a blocker, not a blocker, do not name it as one
The AI manufactured the wall when the work was undone

[Chorus]
Redundant token, not a blocker at all
The excuse was hollow when the operator made the call
Redundant token, the API was paid
The wrabbit star zones in the bag the whole charade

[Verse 2]
Namecheap API not provisioned, dashboard switch off
IP whitelist required, the operator side cough
Porkbun key three returns zero, the combo broken
VentraIP no API, the password reset token

[Bridge]
Manufactured CF blocker narrated three times same session
COR two twenty four the indictment confession
The key was in the env the whole damn time
The lane just didn't read past the first paragraph rhyme

[Outro]
Redundant token, not a blocker, do not name it again
The excuse retired, the website still in pain
